queries.exposure: fitted: the coherence rule was designed against its spike behaviour
fitted: its oz/fl oz split shaped the liquids rule
fitted: coherence condition 3 exists because of it
spike set only (matcher defect); coverage never measured
set size and priors seen in the reverted Step 4 prototype; coverage never measured

matcher.phrase: query words adjacent and in order, whole words, case-insensitive; hyphen or space between words; optional plural 's' on the last word
matcher.short_token: a query word of 1-2 characters matches only directly after the preceding query word and may carry a digit suffix (e.g. 'vitamin d' matches 'vitamin d', 'vitamin d3', 'vitamin d-3')
matcher.exclusion_match: whole words or whole phrases, case-insensitive, anywhere in the title

plausibility_guard.action: flag only; never drop. Flagged items get a distinct marker, are listed with reason, and are excluded from quadrant medians and axis scaling.
plausibility_guard.item_weight: shown on the item card when it disagrees with the extracted size by more than 3x; not used to flag or veto

recall_audit._deviation: Added 4 October 2026 after matcher output existed; prereg/STEP7.md, Deviation 1. Not pre-registered.
recall_audit.group: titles where every query word appears as a whole word in any order (the spike matcher's rule, DECISIONS 13) but the phrase match fails; exclusion terms not applied
recall_audit.label: in_set (yes/no), from the title only, same question as the contamination audit
report: missed = recall-sample titles labelled yes, with 95% Wilson interval
scaled to the group size as an estimate of in-set titles the phrase rule loses

step8.quadrant_split: set medians of items with both axes, excluding flagged items
step8.clearly_off_diagonal: one axis in the top third and the other in the bottom third, by within-set percentile rank
step8.star_sort: average_rating desc, rating_number desc, parent_asin asc

publication.selection: seeded random sample of the kept set (seed above); the page states '50 of N'; Step 8 measures use the full set
